contentHtml:
It comes as no surprise that process of obtaining an Emirates visa can get quite stressful. But when you have the right information and support, it becomes simple.

The need to understand the emirates visa requirements ring true for many reasons. Planning your vacation, continuing your studies and working in the country – all of these rely on you being prepared for these requirements.

In this article, we explain very step. So you will be meeting all the criteria without a hitch.

Types of Emirates Visas

The UAE offers different visa types. Each of them caters to different needs and durations. Knowing which one fits your situation helps with your application process.

Tourist Visa

Explore UAE’ culture and modern attraction. A tourist visa is ideal in this regard. It is a short term one. This visa allows visitors to enjoy their brief stay in the country.

  • Duration
    Usually 30 or 90 days

Requirements

®   Valid passport

®   passport-sized photos

®   travel itinerary

®   proof of accommodation

®   a return ticket

Tourist visas are easy to obtain. That’s what makes them perfect for leisure travelers hitting the iconic destinations.

Transit Visa

Travelers passing through UAE on their way to another destination require a transit visa. It’s a short-term option. One that allows passengers to step out of the airport. This way they can experience a quick glimpse of the Emirates.

o   The duration of transit visa is somewhere between 48 to 96 hours.

You are going to need

ü  A valid onward ticket

ü  Passport

ü  a confirmed hotel reservation

With this visa, travelers can enjoy brief stays. They do not have the need for an extended permit either.

Visit Visa

Reuniting with their family or friends in the UAE, a visit visa is suitable. This visa offers flexibility in duration. It allows for longer stays than a tourist visa.

Visit visa is extendable. Its duration goes as far as 90 days.

Applying for this visa calls for

o   Sponsorship by a UAE resident

o   Passport

o   supporting documents

A visit visa is ideal for extended vacations. It provides enough time to travel around and make some connections.

Student Visa

For pursuing education in UAE, a student visa is available as an option. Be it enrolling in a university or specialized courses, this visa lets you stay for your program’s duration.

All you need for applying encompass:

  • Acceptance letter from a UAE educational institution
  • Your passport
  • proof of financial support

This visa ensures students can fully focus on their education. Meanwhile it means they are meeting their necessary emirates UAE visa requirements.

Work Visa

Anyone who wants to build a professional career in this country needs a work visa. It also requires a sponsorship from a UAE based company. Not to mention there are many steps involved to ensure compliance.

Emirates Work Visa Requirements

Getting a work visa is a multi-step process. One that calls for some serious attention to detail. That’s why we take a look at what’s needed. So you can fulfill your visa requirements Emirates:

Sponsorship by an Employer

An employer in the UAE must sponsor you for a work visa. This sponsorship works as a guarantee. The company takes responsibility for your stay and employment in the country.

  • Sponsorship includes issuing an offer letter
  • The employer initiates the visa process on behalf of their employee

Required Documents

To get a work visa, you’ll need to prepare various documents. Connect Staff can assist in gathering and verifying these. We make sure everything is in order.

Common documents include

  • Your passport copies with a minimum validity of six months
  • Your passport sized photos
  • Educational certificates attested by relevant authorities
  • Employment offer letter from your sponsoring company

These documents are necessary as part of emirates visa requirements. They result in a smooth application process.

Medical and Security Screening

Before the visa is issued, applicants have to get a thorough medical check up. They need to screened for health as well as security risks. This screening verifies the employees are fit for work and meet safety standards.

Screening steps

  1. Health check for contagious diseases
  2. Background check for any legal issues

Connect Staff manages these steps. We make the process stress free. With us, you do not have to worry about meeting all visa requirements in Emirates.

Process Timeline

The timeline for securing a work visa is different for everyone. Document preparation and approval stages affect how long it is going to take. The process may take a few weeks. This starts from when you submit the documents. It ends when you finally receiving the permit.
